# Clarivue

> Interview readiness platform for career centers, workforce programs, and post-secondary institutions.

Clarivue helps workforce programs and bootcamps detect interview readiness gaps before learners fail real interviews — reducing remediation cycles, protecting employer trust, and enabling institutions to scale enrollment profitably without expanding advisor headcount.

## What Clarivue Does

- **Interview Readiness Engine**: AI-powered mock interviews that score learners on role-specific competencies, behavioral storytelling, and technical fluency.
- **Cohort Performance Board**: Real-time dashboard showing which learners are interview-ready, at risk, or critical — across an entire cohort.
- **Readiness Actions**: Automated remediation workflows that assign targeted practice based on each learner's specific breakdown patterns.
- **ROI Calculator**: Model the financial impact of structured interview preparation on advisor hours, failed placement costs, and employer confidence.

##Detailed description (one-pager lead):
Workforce development programs face a scaling paradox: they need higher placement rates to unlock funding and protect 
employer partnerships, but detecting interview skill gaps late means endless remediation cycles that burn advisor time 
and prevent growth. Clarivue solves this by surfacing readiness gaps early through AI-powered interview intelligence 
— so institutions can intervene before learners fail real interviews, maintain the employer trust that drives repeat 
hiring, and scale program capacity without proportional increases in coaching staff.

## Who It's For

- Career services teams at colleges and universities
- Workforce development programs (WDBs, nonprofits, government-funded)
- Employer-connected training programs and bootcamps
- Any institution that refers learners to employer interviews

## Core Value Proposition

hen learners fail interviews, institutions pay the price in three ways: advisor teams spend 6–10 unplanned hours per learner 
on remediation, employer partners lose trust and stop sending opportunities, and low placement rates put grant renewals 
and accreditation at risk.Clarivue helps institutions detect interview readiness gaps early — before learners meet 
employers — so they can protect recruiter relationships, scale placement support efficiently, and maintain the outcomes that unlock continued funding

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **What is Clarivue?** — Clarivue is an interview readiness platform for career centers, workforce programs, and post-secondary institutions that uses AI-powered mock interviews to detect readiness gaps before learners fail real interviews.
- **Who is Clarivue designed for?** — Career services teams at colleges and universities, workforce development programs, employer-connected training programs, bootcamps, and any institution that refers learners to employer interviews.
- **How does the Interview Readiness Engine work?** — AI-powered mock interviews score learners on role-specific competencies, behavioral storytelling, and technical fluency, surfacing gaps early so advisors can intervene.
- **What is the Cohort Performance Board?** — A real-time dashboard showing which learners are interview-ready, at risk, or critical across an entire cohort.
- **How does Clarivue help reduce advisor workload?** — Automated Readiness Actions assign targeted practice based on each learner's breakdown patterns, reducing the 6–10 unplanned remediation hours per learner.
- **Can I see Clarivue's ROI impact?** — Yes. Use the ROI Calculator at https://clarivue.io/roicalculator to model the financial impact for your program.
- **How does Clarivue protect employer partnerships?** — By ensuring learners are interview-ready before they meet employers, preventing failed placements that erode recruiter trust.
- **Does Clarivue offer a demo?** — Yes. Book one at https://clarivue.io/book-demo.
